rationale: S-0088-02 proposes auditing the AIS-to-soma Nav ratio computation for cluster 1 (cells 1304/1504/1624/1634), where t0088 reported a 116x ratio = +33 sigma above Werginz 2024's 17.3 +/- 3 (the most extreme single-prior violation in either t0086 or t0088). t0090 (morphology generator + diversity test) covers this scope in Phase G as part of the bundled validation triplet, ahead of t0091's morphology-extended NSGA-II so the audited ratio is available for biological-plausibility scoring. Rejecting as covered.
